name: ai-chat-reveal
title: AI Chat Reveal
description: A question is typed in a chat app, sent, and answered by an AI that streams its reply word by word on a measured token rhythm: thinking dot, uneven bursts, a bulleted list. Question, answer and four beat times are variables; placement full (app with header and Russian keyboard) or top / bottom (a white chat card); holds the finished answer to the end of the mount.
author: Miao Yang
